scene: Through the telescope lens, three distant transport stations gleam across the bay.
picture: First-person circular view through brass telescope crosshairs. Far left, a wicker cloud cable pod rocks gently beside a mast. Centre, an illuminated streamlined bullet train rests along a neon platform. Right, a sinuous green maglev dragon train hums silently above an elevated rail, ready for departure.
shown: A wicker cloud cable pod docked at a wooden pylon on the left
A sleek silver bullet train halted at a glass terminal in the centre
A glowing maglev dragon train waiting beside a curved neon platform on the right
